class.name: PhysXSkinnedCloth3D
class.brief_description: Character cloth on any GPU: replaces one surface of a skinned [MeshInstance3D] with a cloth simulated from the skeleton's final pose, provided by the PhysX module.
class.description: Point [member mesh_instance_path] at a skinned [MeshInstance3D]: its surface is hidden and redrawn from the cloth simulation, pinned around [member pin_height] with per-vertex [member max_distances], colliding with the skeleton's physical-bone capsules (or capsules fitted to [member body_mesh_path]). The pose is captured in the skeleton's [code]skeleton_updated[/code] window, so the cloth follows the FINAL pose -- after IK, spring bones and any [SkeletonModifier3D]. The simulation steps with the world's gravity (the physics space's default gravity, from the project settings) unless [member use_world_gravity] is off, plus [member extra_acceleration] for the game's own force fields and wind; [method get_effective_gravity] reports what it steps with.

method.name: get_effective_gravity
method.description: The gravity the cloth steps with right now: the world's default gravity (or [member fixed_gravity] when [member use_world_gravity] is off) plus [member extra_acceleration], in m/s².

members.member: Optional skinned [MeshInstance3D] whose surface gets collision capsules fitted to it, used when the skeleton has no physical bones to collide the cloth with.
Extra acceleration (m/s²) added on top of the resolved gravity every step: the game's force fields, wind, updrafts.
The gravity used when [member use_world_gravity] is off, in m/s².
Per-vertex maximum distance (m) each surface vertex may travel from its pinned position; empty = derived automatically from [member pin_height].
The skinned [MeshInstance3D] whose surface the cloth replaces: that surface is hidden and redrawn from the simulation.
Bind-space height (m) at and above which vertices follow the animation instead of the simulation (the pinned region).
Steps with the physics space's default gravity (the [code]physics/3d/default_gravity[/code] and [code]physics/3d/default_gravity_vector[/code] project settings) instead of [member fixed_gravity].
